s: Paul warns against false teachers. Christ came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the first.
Pray for all people, for God wants all to be saved. One mediator, Christ Jesus.
The qualities of bishops and deacons. The great mystery of godliness.
Warnings about false teaching. Be an example to the faithful.
How to treat widows, elders and servants.
The love of money is the root of all evils. Fight the good fight of faith.

4: In older English “meat” meant any food, not only flesh.
In older English “conversation” meant way of life and conduct, not talk.
5: In older English “corn” meant any grain, such as wheat or barley.
